trace.question: What was the fastest lap speed among all drivers in the 2009 Spanish Grand Prix?
trace.evidence: the fastest lap speed among all refers to max(fastestLapSpeed); Spanish Grand Prix refers to races.name = 'Spanish Grand Prix';

attempts.sql:
SELECT MAX(CAST(r.fastestLapSpeed AS REAL)) AS fastest_lap_speed
FROM results r
JOIN races ra ON r.raceId = ra.raceId
WHERE ra.name = 'Spanish Grand Prix'
  AND ra.year = 2009

trace.final_sql:
SELECT MAX(CAST(r.fastestLapSpeed AS REAL)) AS fastest_lap_speed
FROM results r
JOIN races ra ON r.raceId = ra.raceId
WHERE ra.name = 'Spanish Grand Prix'
  AND ra.year = 2009
trace.answer: The fastest lap speed in the 2009 Spanish Grand Prix was 202.484 km/h.
